Why are you here and how can we help?

If you’re here for

Business

Coimbatore offers the ideal environment for any business to set-up and flourish. A comprehensive entrepreneurial ecosystem is available for you. From vendors who can supply all kinds of products and services to facilitation organisations like CII, Chamber of Commerce everything is available. When you need specialised help technical support entities like SITRA, COINIDIA etc are available.

If you’re here for

Education

The ecosystem that makes dreams come true is powered by sterling educational institutions. In fact, the country’s first polytechnic college was established in Coimbatore. Alternate schools and international schools offer a mix of curriculum. Colleges with a special focus on commerce, literature, and engineering create industry-ready students. Entrepreneurship hubs and incubators help facilitate future ideas. Today, the city has 400+ colleges churning out over 100,000 graduates a year across almost every discipline.

If you’re here for

Health

Coimbatore is amongst one of the best healthcare centres in India and probably even South Asia. 500+ small and large hospitals with over 10,000 in-patient beds combined provide treatment in all domains of health. Some of the world’s best doctors and paramedics call this city their home. Many world-class medical equipment are launched in Coimbatore due to the solid health infrastructure available here. This combined with a good weather, support system in terms of home nurses, economical lodging facilities makes the city an ideal healthcare destination.

If you’re here for

Tourism

Coimbatore is primarily a business hub. But it is also the gateway to many tourism opportunities. Apart from being the home of Isha yoga center which attracts both yoga fans and tourists alike, the city is the perfect “break-journey” centre for many locations. The airport, railway station and road infrastructure along with lodging facilities make Coimbatore the base destination for your travels to: Ooty, Coonoor, Munnar, Kodaikanal, National forests at Bandipur/Masanagudi.

If you’re here for

Retirement

Peace, salubrious weather and caring population – what else will one need while spending your retirement years? Coimbatore offers all these along with two of the most critical elements for old age – Solid healthcare infrastructure and for those who wish, a large inventory of old-age homes too. The minimal hustle and bustle and closeness to a rustic lifestyle give the city the feel of a soothing and comfortable home where you can spend your retirement doing lots of interesting things or just relaxing.

If you’re here for

Employment

Companies and industries that operate in almost every domain. Small and large companies that perform backend operations for global leaders. Startups and SMEs who offer challenging assignments in their growth stories. All this and much more awaits a potential employment seeker in Coimbatore. There are innumerable opportunities for every kind (well, almost every kind) of skillset – generic or specialised. The highly intellectual and academic nature of the city will help you grow as a person. Reasonable cost of living, good infrastructure, lovely weather and good people make Coimbatore the ideal place in your search for a career.

If you’re here to

Startup

Coimbatore is an important player in the startup environment. Way before all the startup discussions and conclaves, Coimbatore hosted Endex 1982, an event for new entrepreneurs. This spirit of entrepreneurship certainly has something to do with the city’s history of overcoming difficulties with ingenuity and sheer will. This has created an atmosphere that nurtures and engenders ideas. Businesses small and large flourish in the city. From a grandmother who sells idlis to e-waste disposal businesses, Coimbatore has room for everyone. And for every idea.

If you’re here to

Invest

Coimbatore is amongst one of India’s fastest growing Tier II cities and is well on its way to becoming a metropolis. Whether you wish to invest in real estate, startups or other assets, it provides you the opportunity to enter at competitive prices. Growth is uni-directional at present (upwards) and you can unlock value from your investment in the short and medium term as well.
